name: combat_miss_penalty
about: Clicks at the sky: two in one frame (1.8.9's 10-tick miss penalty eats the second swing), single taps, pressing at the sky and holding while looking down at the floor (1.7.10 digs at once, 1.8.9 after the penalty), a sky click followed by a player click.

steps.note: two taps in one frame at the sky
press at the sky and hold
look down at the floor while holding
a sky click, then a player click
hold at the sky, then look at the player while holding
